mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_process_managers WHERE process_id = #{processId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM order_process_managers WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND waiting_for = #{waitingFor} AND status = 'WAITING_RESULT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_process_managers( process_id, order_id, process_type, status, current_step, waiting_for, command_id, command_fingerprint, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, result_deadline_at, next_check_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{processId}, #{orderId}, #{processType}, 'WAITING_RESULT', #{processType}, #{waitingFor}, #{commandId}, #{fingerprint}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, #{deadline}, #{deadline}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO order_command_outbox( command_id, process_id, order_id, target_service, command_type, payload, payload_fingerprint, status, result_deadline_at, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, created_at ) VALUES ( #{commandId}, #{processId}, #{orderId}, #{target}, #{commandType}, #{payload}, #{fingerprint}, 'NEW', #{deadline}, #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT result_id, payload_fingerprint, processing_status FROM order_result_inbox WHERE result_id = #{resultId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_result_inbox( result_id, order_id, result_type, outcome, payload_fingerprint, payload, processing_status, correlation_id, causation_id, traceparent, received_at ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{orderId}, #{resultType}, #{outcome}, #{fingerprint}, #{payload}, 'RECEIVED', #{correlationId}, #{causationId}, #{traceparent}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE order_result_inbox SET process_id = #{processId}, processing_status = #{status}, error_detail = #{detail}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND processing_status = 'RECEIVED'

UPDATE order_process_managers SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, version = version + 1, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE process_id = #{processId} AND status = 'WAITING_RESULT'
UPDATE order_command_outbox SET status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until = NULL WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status IN ('NEW','IN_FLIGHT','RETRY')

UPDATE order_process_managers SET status = 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', last_error = 'Result deadline expired; remote outcome remains unknown', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'WAITING_RESULT' AND result_deadline_at <= #{now}

UPDATE order_process_managers SET status = 'WAITING_RESULT', attempts = attempts + 1, next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt}, recovered_by = #{operator}, recovery_reason = #{reason}, recovered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE process_id = #{processId} AND status IN ('COMPENSATION_REQUIRED','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED')
